confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate. No live menus, listings or booking pages were checked, and July 2026 values are projected from knowledge that runs to about June 2026. Beer assumes a roughly 0.5 L draft. Coffee and restaurant anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel rates, which swing with peak-season demand and regional conditions. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weaker. FX came from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a source. The basis is general knowledge of Tel Aviv's own price level, loosely cross-checked against high-cost Western European and Eastern Mediterranean cities, with a July peak-season uplift applied to accommodation.
